title: The person's own commands and undos as steps of DCLab Code's M6 episodes
request: Keep going: add the person's commands and undos to the step-by-step training data.
plan: Merge the person's acts with the agent's steps in file order
Keep only the act and its outcome code
Weight by who made the steps

decisions.decision: A command's text and output never enter the episode
decisions.why: M6 states carry no content; the agent's own Bash steps keep no command either

decisions.decision: Silver while Claude made steps, gold for the person's alone
decisions.why: an Episode has one weight; the owner's rule: Claude silver, people gold

change: sets/dclab_code.py: person steps (person:Bash, person:undo) in the episode's timeline, placed by the command's recorded start; DCLab Code records person_command_start (dclab-code 3955c69).

findings.defect: the test did not prove the merge order
findings.scenario: appending the person's steps unsorted still passed
findings.cause: the step before the first undo was an Edit either way
findings.fix: the whole step list is asserted

findings.defect: a command run during an agent turn landed after the agent's edits
findings.scenario: ! make test for 60 s while the agent edits at +5 s read as Edit, then the test
findings.cause: only the command's end was recorded
findings.fix: DCLab Code records its start first; the builder places the step there

findings.defect: the episode's weight said the steps were all Claude's
findings.scenario: a session of the person's commands alone was labelled Claude's, silver
findings.fix: silver while Claude made steps, gold otherwise; the docs say so

measurements.name: store tests and the store check
measurements.gate: every store test passes and the store check passes all its checks

outcome: DCLab Code's episodes show what the agent and the person each did, in order, with no content.
lessons: Record where an act starts, not only where it ends, when other acts run meanwhile
Assert a whole order, not one neighbour
